description: This file contains the PHP class 'Modification' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Marketplace' namespace. It is part of OpenCart's admin interface for managing marketplace modifications, including listing, refreshing, and handling modification files and XML configs.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace modifications in OpenCart's admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the modifications page; loads language, sets page title, builds URL with sorting and pagination, and renders the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the modifications list with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modifications with sorting options and prepares data for listing.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes modifications by reloading XML configs, clearing caches, and handling maintenance mode if needed.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables a specified modification by its ID, setting its status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a specified modification by its ID, setting its status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected modifications by their IDs.
